and Allied facilities at Garvi Gujarat (New

General Administration Department 
Resolution No.NVK-102018-1317-kh-3 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar 
Date: September, 2019 
·~-7 SE? 2019 
Preamble: 
As a part of the basic administrative framework of the State Government, the Office of 
the Resident Commissioner in the National Capital, New Delhi is mandated to promote Centre­
State and Inter-state cooperation, investment promotion and protocol in the larger interests of 
the State and to strengthen ties with the Union Governrr.ent and with other states. For 
achieving these fundamental objectives, there is a Gujarat Bhawan at 11, Kautilya Marg, 
Chankyapuri, New Delhi. However, the building of this Bhawan is very old and the 
infrastructure has been found to be inadequate. Hence, Government of Gujarat has constructed 
a second guest house namely" Garvi Gujarat "at 25B Akbar Road, New Delhi with modern, cost 
effective and environment friendly amenities. 
The total number of suites/rooms in this State Guest House is 78 and they are

compared to those existing in the old building of Gujarat Bhawan which has been in operation 
since 1965 at 11 Kautilya Marg, Chankyapuri, New Delhi, it would not be appropriate to 
continue the prevailing tariff structure of old Gujarat Bhawan in Garvi Gujarat.

vi) 
Period of 24 hours from the time of allotment of suite will be counted as 1 (one) day. 
Period less than 24 hours will also be counted as 1 (one) day. 
vii) 
The guests should enter all necessary information in the prescribed format online or at 
the reception desk and the suite/room will be allotted thereafter. 
viii) 
Reservation of suites is non-transferable. A person other than that in whose name the 
suite/room is provided at the time of registration of reservation, will not be permitted 
to stay in the " Garvi Gujarat". 
ix) 
It is necessary that photo identity cards in respect of all the persons staying in the 
suite/room are provided at the time of registration of reservation and entries made in 
the requisite register. 
x) 
Reservation will not be given to persons headquartered in New Delhi. 
xi) 
Extra bedding will not be provided in the suites. 
xii) 
The full tariff in respect of guests in Category "I" (Private) must be deposited in advance 
in cash. 
xiii) 
If any article of the Guest House is lost or broken by the guest, an amount double the 
prevailing market rate of the article will be charged as compensation and this amount 
will be included in the bill at the time of checking out. 
xiv) 
In case of any matter other than that which is not covered under the rules issued by the 
Government, the decision of the Resident Commissioner, Government of Gujarat on any 
such matter(s) shall be final. 
xv)

Terms and Conditions: 
i) 
Reservation in respect of all the above facilities will be available to the guests in 
Categories A to H in table 2 as well as to various authorities and corporations of the 
Central and State Government. 
ii) 
Full amount of tariff must be deposited in advance as per prescribed procedure. 
iii) 
Reservation for the facilities mentioned in Table-3 will not be given to private persons. 
However, Resident Commissioner shall have the powers to make exceptions in certain 
cases. 
iv) 
The organizers of events must ensure that usual guests staying in the guest house are 
not inconvenienced on account of the event/s arranged by them. Furniture/acoustics 
system other than those installed in the hall shall not be allowed to be used under any 
circumstances. 
v) 
Littering and/ or despoiling the guest house premises is strictly prohibited. If any such 
act is noticed, the cost of damage/cleaning as decided by the management committee 
will be recovered from the concerned. 
vi) 
The allottee must take care of the lawns/tree/shrubs in the premises of "Garvi Gujarat". 
In case of any damage, compensation as decided by the management committee shall be 
recovered from the allottee. 
vii) 
Garvi Gujarat management will not be responsible for parking of vehicles during events. 
The concerned allottees are required to arrange for parking on their own. 
viii) 
Advance reservation of common facilities is liable to be cancelled during the visits of 
Hon'ble Governor/ Hon'ble Chief Minister/Hon'ble Dy. Chief Minister/ Hon'ble Chief 
Justice etc or when such facility is required for other purposes in public interest. 
ix) 
Facilities at" Garvi Gujarat" shall not be used for any religious purposes. 
x) 
If reservation is required to be cancelled by the allottee concerned, 80% of the advance 
amount deposited will be refunded. However, no deduction will be made for change in 
reservation by the management. 
xi) 
The right to entertain or reject the application for the purpose of booking of facilities 
mentioned vests with Resident Commissioner or any officer authorized on his behalf. 
3. 
The chargeable tariffs for the Suites/Rooms and Allied Facilities at the Garvi Gujarat 
will come into effect from date of issue of this government Resolution.

vi) 
Period of 24 hours from the time of allotment of suite will be counted as 1 (one) day. 
Period less than 24 hours will also be counted as 1 (one) day. 
vii) 
The guests should enter all necessary information in the prescribed format online or at 
the reception desk and the suite/room will be allotted thereafter. 
viii) 
Reservation of suites is non-transferable. A person other than that in whose name the 
suite/room is provided at the time of registration of reservation, will not be permitted 
to stay in the " Garvi Gujarat". 
ix) 
It is necessary that photo identity cards in respect of all the persons staying in the 
suite/room are provided at the time of registration of reservation and entries made in 
the requisite register. 
x) 
Reservation will not be given to persons headquartered in New Delhi. 
xi) 
Extra bedding will not be provided in the suites. 
xii) 
The full tariff in respect of guests in Category "I" (Private) must be deposited in advance 
in cash. 
xiii) 
If any article of the Guest House is lost or broken by the guest, an amount double the 
prevailing market rate of the article will be charged as compensation and this amount 
will be included in the bill at the time of checking out. 
xiv) 
In case of any matter other than that which is not covered under the rules issued by the 
Government, the decision of the Resident Commissioner, Government of Gujarat on any 
such matter(s) shall be final.

Terms and Conditions: 
i) 
Reservation in respect of all the above facilities will be available to the guests in 
Categories A to H in table 2 as well as to various authorities and corporations of the 
Central and State Government. 
ii) 
Full amount of tariff must be deposited in advance as per prescribed procedure. 
iii) 
Reservation for the facilities mentioned in Table-3 will not be given to private persons. 
However, Resident Commissioner shall have the powers to make exceptions in certain 
cases. 
iv) 
The organizers of events must ensure that usual guests staying in the guest house are 
not inconvenienced on account of the event/s arranged by them. Furniture/acoustics 
system other than those installed in the hall shall not be allowed to be used under any 
circumstances. 
v) 
Littering and/ or despoiling the guest house premises is strictly prohibited. If any such 
act is noticed, the cost of damage/cleaning as decided by the management committee 
will be recovered from the concerned. 
vi) 
The allottee must take care of the lawns/tree/shrubs in the premises of "Garvi Gujarat". 
In case of any damage, compensation as decided by the management committee shall be 
recovered from the allottee. 
vii) 
Garvi Gujarat management will not be responsible for parking of vehicles during events. 
The concerned allottees are required to arrange for parking on their own. 
viii) 
Advance reservation of common facilities is liable to be cancelled during the visits of 
Hon'ble Governor/ Hon'ble Chief Minister/Hon'ble Dy. Chief Minister/ Hon'ble Chief 
Justice etc or when such facility is required for other purposes in public interest. 
ix) 
Facilities at" Garvi Gujarat" shall not be used for any religious purposes. 
x) 
If reservation is required to be cancelled by the allottee concerned, 80% of the advance 
amount deposited will be refunded. However, no deduction will be made for change in 
reservation by the management. 
xi) 
The right to entertain or reject the application for the purpose of booking of facilities 
mentioned vests with Resident Commissioner or any officer authorized on his behalf. 
3. 
The chargeable tariffs for the Suites/Rooms and Allied Facilities at the Garvi Gujarat 
will come into effect from date of issue of this government Resolution.

Preamble: 
As a part of the basic administrative framework of the State Government, the Office of 
the Resident Commissioner in the National Capital, New Delhi is mandated to promote Centre­
State and Inter-state cooperation, investment promotion and protocol in the larger interests of 
the State and to strengthen ties with the Union Governrr.ent and with other states. For 
achieving these fundamental objectives, there is a Gujarat Bhawan at 11, Kautilya Marg, 
Chankyapuri, New Delhi. However, the building of this Bhawan is very old and the 
infrastructure has been found to be inadequate. Hence, Government of Gujarat has constructed 
a second guest house namely" Garvi Gujarat "at 25B Akbar Road, New Delhi with modern, cost 
effective and environment friendly amenities.

Terms and Conditions: 
i) 
The facilities at Garvi Gujarat will be used for fulfilling the fundamental objectives as 
mentioned in the Preamble. These facilities can be allotted to the private persons 
considering their status and need but subject to availability. 
ii) 
Officers of a rank equivalent to Secretary and above may be allowed to book rooms in 
Garvi Gujarat so that both Guest Houses can be utilized properly. 
· iii) 
All the distinguished guests staying in the guest house shall be required to adhere to the 
conduct & discipline as expected of a public servant. 
iv) 
The reservation/ allotment of rooms for the 'private persons' other than CPSUs and 
SPSUs in category "I" will be done on the basis of reference from VIPs/Senior 
Government Officers 
v) 
Tariff will be charged for the whole suite/room as a unit without consideration of 
occupancy of less number of beds. 
3

vi) 
Period of 24 hours from the time of allotment of suite will be counted as 1 (one) day. 
Period less than 24 hours will also be counted as 1 (one) day. 
vii) 
The guests should enter all necessary information in the prescribed format online or at 
the reception desk and the suite/room will be allotted thereafter. 
viii) 
Reservation of suites is non-transferable. A person other than that in whose name the 
suite/room is provided at the time of registration of reservation, will not be permitted 
to stay in the " Garvi Gujarat". 
ix) 
It is necessary that photo identity cards in respect of all the persons staying in the 
suite/room are provided at the time of registration of reservation and entries made in 
the requisite register. 
x) 
Reservation will not be given to persons headquartered in New Delhi. 
xi) 
Extra bedding will not be provided in the suites. 
xii) 
The full tariff in respect of guests in Category "I" (Private) must be deposited in advance 
in cash. 
xiii) 
If any article of the Guest House is lost or broken by the guest, an amount double the 
prevailing market rate of the article will be charged as compensation and this amount 
will be included in the bill at the time of checking out. 
xiv) 
In case of any matter other than that which is not covered under the rules issued by the 
Government, the decision of the Resident Commissioner, Government of Gujarat on any 
such matter(s) shall be final. 
xv) 
Consumption 
premises. 
of alcohol and non-vegetarian food is prohibited in Garvi Gujarat 
xvi) 
It shall be desirable that guests clear all dues and collect a receipt for the same before 
checking out.

Terms and Conditions: 
i) 
Reservation in respect of all the above facilities will be available to the guests in 
Categories A to H in table 2 as well as to various authorities and corporations of the 
Central and State Government. 
ii) 
Full amount of tariff must be deposited in advance as per prescribed procedure. 
iii) 
Reservation for the facilities mentioned in Table-3 will not be given to private persons. 
However, Resident Commissioner shall have the powers to make exceptions in certain 
cases. 
iv) 
The organizers of events must ensure that usual guests staying in the guest house are 
not inconvenienced on account of the event/s arranged by them. Furniture/acoustics 
system other than those installed in the hall shall not be allowed to be used under any 
circumstances. 
v) 
Littering and/ or despoiling the guest house premises is strictly prohibited. If any such 
act is noticed, the cost of damage/cleaning as decided by the management committee 
will be recovered from the concerned. 
vi) 
The allottee must take care of the lawns/tree/shrubs in the premises of "Garvi Gujarat". 
In case of any damage, compensation as decided by the management committee shall be 
recovered from the allottee. 
vii) 
Garvi Gujarat management will not be responsible for parking of vehicles during events. 
The concerned allottees are required to arrange for parking on their own. 
viii) 
Advance reservation of common facilities is liable to be cancelled during the visits of 
Hon'ble Governor/ Hon'ble Chief Minister/Hon'ble Dy. Chief Minister/ Hon'ble Chief 
Justice etc or when such facility is required for other purposes in public interest. 
ix) 
Facilities at" Garvi Gujarat" shall not be used for any religious purposes. 
x) 
If reservation is required to be cancelled by the allottee concerned, 80% of the advance 
amount deposited will be refunded. However, no deduction will be made for change in 
reservation by the management. 
xi) 
The right to entertain or reject the application for the purpose of booking of facilities 
mentioned vests with Resident Commissioner or any officer authorized on his behalf. 
3. 
The chargeable tariffs for the Suites/Rooms and Allied Facilities at the Garvi Gujarat 
will come into effect from date of issue of this government Resolution.
